matthew.19.p1.b1.text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.

matthew.19.p1.b2.text: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.

matthew.19.p1.b3.text: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking,

matthew.19.p1.b4.text: Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?

matthew.19.p2.b1.text: from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’

matthew.19.p2.b2.text: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?

matthew.19.p2.b3.text: So they are no longer two, but one flesh.

matthew.19.p2.b4.text: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.

matthew.19.p3.b1.text: Why then, … did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?

matthew.19.p3.b2.text: Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart; but it was not this way from the beginning.

matthew.19.p3.b3.text: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman, commits adultery.

matthew.19.p4.b1.text: If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.

matthew.19.p4.b2.text: Not everyone can accept this word, … but only those to whom it has been given.

matthew.19.p4.b3.text: … still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.

matthew.19.p5.b1.text: Then the little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them.

matthew.19.p5.b2.text: And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

matthew.19.p5.b3.text: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.

matthew.19.p5.b4.text: And after He had placed His hands on them, He went on from there.

matthew.19.p6.b1.text: Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?

matthew.19.p6.b2.text: Why do you ask Me about what is good? … There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.

matthew.19.p6.b4.text: Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.

matthew.19.p7.b1.text: All these I have kept, … What do I still lack?

matthew.19.p7.b2.text: If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.

matthew.19.p7.b3.text: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.

matthew.19.p8.b1.text: Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.

matthew.19.p8.b2.text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”

matthew.19.p9.b2.text: With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

matthew.19.p10.b1.text: Look, … we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?

matthew.19.p10.b2.text: Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne,

matthew.19.p10.b3.text: you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

matthew.19.p11.b1.text: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.

matthew.19.p11.b2.text: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
